CNFThreeClausePacking:
∃ pack : List Bool → List Bool,
      PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime (fun x : List Bool => x) (fun x : List Bool => x) pack ∧
      ∀ φ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF, PEqualNP.Search.IsKCNF 3 φ →
        let small := PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF ((φ.filter (fun c => c.length ≤ 2)).reverse)
        let groups := (φ.filterMap (fun c => if c.length = 3 then some (c.getD 0 (0,false),
          c.getD 1 (0,false), c.getD 2 (0,false)) else none)).reverse
        let packed := groups.foldr (fun group rest =>
          let a := PEqualNP.Search.encodeClause [group.1]
          let b := PEqualNP.Search.encodeClause [group.2.1]
          let c := PEqualNP.Search.encodeClause [group.2.2]
          let bc := List.replicate b.length true ++ false :: (b ++ c)
          let abc := List.replicate a.length true ++ false :: (a ++ bc)
          List.replicate abc.length true ++ false :: (abc ++ rest)) []
        pack (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ) = List.replicate small.length true ++ false :: (small ++ packed)
IndexedWitnessProjection:
∀ (R : Set (List Bool × List Bool))
    (hR : PEqualNP.Library.DecidableInPolyTime PEqualNP.Library.encodePair R)
    (clock : List Bool → List Bool)
    (hc : PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime (fun x : List Bool => x) (fun x : List Bool => x) clock)
    (generate : List Bool × List Bool → List Bool)
    (hg : PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime PEqualNP.Library.encodePair (fun x : List Bool => x) generate), {x : List Bool | ∃ i < (clock x).length, (x, generate (List.replicate i true, x)) ∈ R} ∈ PEqualNP.Library.P
LogarithmicThreeClauseSAT:
∀ (q : Polynomial ℕ), ∃ D : Language Bool, D ∈ PEqualNP.Library.P ∧ ∀ φ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF, PEqualNP.Search.IsKCNF 3 φ →
      2 ^ (2 * (φ.filter (fun c => c.length = 3)).length + 1) ≤ q.eval (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ).length →
        (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ ∈ D ↔ PEqualNP.Search.Satisfiable φ)
